bio.text: Robert Sprague, a Republican, is a candidate for Ohio Secretary of State in the November 3, 2026 election and has served as Ohio Treasurer since January 2019.
He represented District 83 in the Ohio House of Representatives from 2011 to 2018, having first been appointed to the seat in February 2011.
Sprague is from Findlay, Ohio, where he was city auditor and treasurer, and he previously worked as a management consultant for Ernst & Young.
He earned a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from Duke University in 1996 and an MBA from the University of North Carolina.
